blocks.text: Do you remember a time when everyone seemed to wish for a life straight out of a Wattpad story? Young readers would imagine themselves living in luxury, studying at prestigious schools, finding their perfect circle of friends, and, of course, meeting their own “prince charming.” The Wattpad era has since cemented itself in the hearts and lives of its readers, offering them a glimpse of a seemingly perfect life filled with romance, friendship, and endless possibilities.
